column1: # The CLI leaves a real battery run executed and asserted (F0.2 of the
# maturity plan). Derived, never edited by hand:

# recorded: 2026-10-12, kaeso-sys-01, isolated roots /tmp/dlxs24h*, scripts/e2e.sh on plan/s24-gitops (3568f895), release build with the five binaries side by side, E2E_IMAGE=alpine:3.20, DELONIX_UPGRADE_FROM=v5.0.2: PASS=1382 FAIL=1 SKIP=14 XFAIL=0 XPASS=0. The one FAIL is the CRI valve check, whose fixtures hardcoded alpine:3.19 against this run's alpine:3.20 (fixed later on this branch to use $IMG); it runs through crictl and counts no leaf. The image pull and the registry 404 check reached the network. The 14 SKIP are host properties (no OPNsense/Proxmox, rootless without NFS, virt-customize and wg present, no VM images, boot units outside the root, CRI root/CNI path, one slirp swept by another engine). Adds the four gitops leaves: 258 + 4 = 262 of 274.
